market_question: Will Oliver Bearman be the 2026 F1 Drivers' Champion?
reasoning: Bearman will be a Haas rookie in 2025. To win the 2026 title, he'd need a top drive and would have to beat elite drivers in only his second season — an extremely rare feat. The true probability is likely well under 0.1% given the competitive landscape and historical precedent, so the market overprices Yes.
evidence_points: Oliver Bearman is contracted to drive for Haas in 2025, a team unlikely to deliver a championship-caliber car by 2026.
Ferrari’s 2026 seats are filled by Leclerc and Hamilton under multi-year deals, blocking the most natural top-team route for the Ferrari junior.
No rookie has won the F1 title in decades, and even elite talents like Verstappen needed multiple seasons to win.
sources_consulted: Publicly known 2025 F1 driver line-ups (Haas confirmed Bearman/Ocon)
Contract statuses of top teams (Ferrari, Red Bull, Mercedes, McLaren)
